item.title: Solved: How to Handle Cython Fatal Error 'numpy/arrayobject.h' No Such File or Directory
item.description: When working with Cython to speed up Python code, encountering the error fatal error: numpy/arrayobject.h: No such file or directory can be frustrating. This error usually indicates that the Cython compiler cannot find the necessary numpy header files during the compilation process.
